name: wb_document_get
description: Read one or more documents, each in its own format: a markdown document as OKF Markdown, a spatial one as JSON Canvas. The format is not a parameter — it follows from what each document was created as, and `kind` on each result says which you got. Each result carries the comment `threads` on the document in full (anchor, status, every message with author and time), and the `proposals` made to it with the status of each change (open, adopted or dismissed), when it has any. Threads and proposals too large to answer whole are trimmed and flagged `annotationsTruncated`. A document that cannot be read is reported in `failed` rather than failing the whole call.

workspaceId.description: Workspace id, <handle>/<segment>, or a segment of your own.

strict.description: JSON Canvas only: drop the x-whiteboard extension so the output is plain JSON Canvas 1.0.

annotations.title: Read a document in its own format

facetsRaw.description: Root frontmatter keys the server does not interpret, kept verbatim under their own names (a note with `created: 2020-01-02` reads back as facetsRaw.created).

nodeId.description: The text node the passage is in; omit for a markdown document's own body.

prefix.description: Text just before the passage, to tell it from a repeat.

exact.description: The passage, quoted exactly as the body has it.

suffix.description: Text just after the passage, to tell it from a repeat.

quote.description: What the passage says; this is what finds it if the text has moved.

start.description: Character offset where the passage starts in the body (or node text) as you read it.

end.description: Character offset just past the end of the passage.

id.description: Your id for this change; any short unique string.

width.description: Box width; text wraps at it. Omit it for the default.

height.description: Box height. Omit it and a text box is made tall enough for its text; a named one too short for the text is refused with the height it needs.
